title: Tables & QR
subtitle: Create table or pickup QR codes your guests can scan. Generate a new QR when you need a printable copy.
qrNotice: Generating a new QR immediately invalidates the previous one. Older token text is never shown again, so generate a new QR when you need to print it.
qrEmptyHint: Create a table or pickup point, then generate its QR to share, download, or print it.
tablesHint: Each active table has one customer entry point. Rename it when the layout changes.
pickupHint: Pickup points are shared entry points for counter or takeaway orders.
rotateConfirm: Generate a new QR? The previous QR will stop working immediately.
deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this entry point? Guests will no longer be able to use it.
renameFailed: Could not rename this entry point.
statusFailed: Could not update this entry point.
loadFailed: Could not load tables and pickup points.
batchHint: Generate printable QR codes for all {count} active entry points at once.
batchEmpty: Add an active table or pickup point to generate a batch.
batchNotice: This rotates every active QR code and immediately invalidates the old ones.
batchRotateConfirm: Generate new QR codes for all {count} active entry points? Every old QR will stop working immediately.
batchFailed: {count} QR codes could not be generated. Check the entry list and try again.
